Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and innovative Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI frameworks. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, AI/ML concepts, prompt engineering, vector databases, and cloud-native deployment architectures. The role involves building scalable GenAI solutions such as AI chatbots, copilots, intelligent search systems, document processing platforms, and AI automation workflows.


Responsibilities

Design and develop Generative AI applications using LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or Mistral
Build and optimize RAG pipelines using embeddings and vector databases
Develop AI copilots, chatbots, document intelligence systems, and multi-agent workflows
Implement prompt engineering, function/tool calling, and AI orchestration frameworks
Fine-tune and evaluate foundation models for enterprise use cases
Integrate GenAI capabilities with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, and cloud platforms
Build scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI
Deploy and monitor AI applications on cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP
Implement LLMOps/MLOps practices including model monitoring, observability, governance, and evaluation
Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI solutions
Ensure responsible AI practices including security, hallucination mitigation, and data privacy


Requirements

Technical Skills

Strong programming skills in Python
Hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI ecosystems
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI APIs, Hugging Face, AutoGen
Knowledge of RAG Architecture
Prompt Engineering
Embeddings
Vector Databases
AI Agents
Experience with vector DBs such as Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus
Understanding of ML/DL fundamentals and Transformer architecture
Experience with cloud services: AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines
Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases


Preferred Skills

Experience in fine-tuning LLMs using LoRA / QLoRA / PEFT
Exposure to multimodal AI systems
Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks and observability tools
Experience with GPU optimization and inference tuning
Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI practices
Exposure to autonomous and agentic AI systems

Gen AI Engineer


Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and implement advanced solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs).
Take full ownership of initiatives, delivering end-to-end solutions with minimal supervision.
Stay current with the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG systems, and applied research.
Build and maintain reusable code libraries, tools, and frameworks to accelerate AI development.
Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
Contribute across the entire software development lifecycle-design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align AI solutions with business goals, integrate contributions into core systems, and influence roadmaps.
Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to design efficient solutions for complex business challenges.
Communicate effectively across technical and non-technical teams, ensuring transparency and alignment.
Own business impact of AI solutions, including adoption, accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency
Translate ambiguous business problems into structured AI solution approaches and measurable outcomes
Drive solution success metrics (e.g., productivity gains, automation %, decision accuracy)
Engage directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, present solutions, and influence decision-making
Communicate solution architecture and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Contribute to client discussions, PoCs, and proposal development.
Design scalable, modular, and production-grade AI systems (APIs, pipelines, orchestration layers)
Define architecture patterns for LLM applications (RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, hybrid systems)
Make trade-offs across latency, cost, accuracy, and maintainability
Build reusable accelerators, frameworks, and components that can be leveraged across multiple use cases and clients
Contribute to internal IP creation (assets, templates, reference architectures)
Ensure reliability and robustness of LLM systems through evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and fallback strategies
Design safe and responsible AI systems (hallucination mitigation, bias handling, governance)
Optimize cost-performance trade-offs in large-scale deployments
Identify when NOT to use LLMs and propose alternative approaches
Contribute to code reviews, design reviews, and mentorship of junior team members
Drive quality standards and best practices across projects
Stay ahead of advancements in GenAI and proactively evaluate their applicability to business problems
Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, training, and capability building.

Must-Have Skills:


Generative AI NLP:

SaaS-based LLMs: LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases, prompt engineering (CoT, ReAct, agents), Azure OpenAI function calling, multimodal models.
Open-Source and SaaS LLMs: Azure OpenAI, Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4, etc.
At least one agentic Generative AI framework: CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, n8n, LangFlow, SmolAgents, Semantic Kernel.
Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems: hybrid retrieval, knowledge graph-based retrieval, multi-hop RAG, hierarchical/contextual retrieval strategies, evaluation/monitoring of RAG pipelines.
Classical NLP: text classification, topic modeling, QA systems, conversational AI/chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, content generation, and Named Entity Recognition (NER).
Databricks ecosystem: Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, AgentBricks
MS Copilot Studio and knowledge on no-code/low-code app development.
MCP server, tools, skills and creation and maintenance of reusable components.

Tech Stack:
Programming Frameworks: Python, FastAPI
Cloud DevOps: Azure DevOps, Agile (Azure Boards)
AI/ML Tools: Azure Databricks, MLFlow Model Lifecycle Management, Unity Catalog (Azure Databricks)
Cloud Services: Azure Function Apps, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure AI Search
Productivity Tools: Microsoft Copilot Studio (basic)


Good-to-Have Skills:


Ops Engineering:
AgentOps / LLMOps:
Agent monitoring, evaluation, and debugging frameworks.
LLM observability and tracing (LangSmith, LangFuse, Weights Biases ).
Prompt/version management and experimentation.
Governance, compliance, and cost optimization for LLMs.
CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.
Flask, Docker.
Other AI/ML Skills:
Document digitization and OCR methods.
Azure Document Intelligence or equivalent.
Azure Delta Lake.
Behavioral Competencies
Flexible to contribute to ad-hoc initiatives such as PoCs, solution prototyping, and proposal workflows.
Open to working on non-GenAI AI/ML projects (e.g., computer vision, document digitization, data structuring, brainstorming for business use cases).
Proactive in providing timely updates and driving tasks to completion.
Demonstrates responsibility, accountability, curiosity, and an innovative mindset.
Willingness to learn and understand the business context (e.g., Philips domain and data landscape) beyond core technical skills.

About the Role:-




We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy LLM-powered applications and autonomous agentic AI systems. You will work closely with product, data, and engineering teams to turn foundation models into reliable, scalable, production-grade solutions.




Key Responsibilities:-



Design and build applications on top of Large Language Models (open-source and proprietary, such as GPT, Claude, Llama, Mistral, and Gemini).
Develop agentic AI workflows where LLMs plan, reason, call tools, and execute multi-step tasks using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, vector search, and re-ranking.
Write clean, modular, and well-tested Python code for data processing, API services, and model integration.
Build and expose APIs (FastAPI or Flask) for LLM-based services and integrate them with enterprise systems.
Fine-tune or adapt models using techniques such as LoRA/QLoRA and instruction tuning when task requirements justify it.
Design prompts, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails to improve output quality, safety, and reliability.
Monitor model performance, latency, cost, and hallucination rates in production; iterate based on metrics.
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and DevOps engineers to define requirements and ship features.
Stay current with advances in LLMs, agent architectures, and GenAI tooling, and share learnings with the team.



Required Skills and Qualifications:-



Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
3+ years of software development experience, with strong proficiency in Python (OOP, async programming, packaging, testing with pytest).
Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs via APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, or similar).
Practical experience with Agentic AI concepts: tool/function calling, ReAct-style reasoning, multi-agent orchestration, and memory management.
Working knowledge of RAG architecture and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or pgvector).
Experience with prompt engineering and evaluation of LLM outputs (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, or custom metrics).
Familiarity with REST API development, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Solid understanding of NLP fundamentals, embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Python, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI application development.

The candidate will work closely with product, engineering, and business teams to build scalable, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions that solve real-world business problems.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI/ML models and AI-powered applications.
Build applications using Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering techniques.
Integrate AI models and third-party AI services into existing applications through APIs.
Develop AI agents, intelligent workflows, and automation solutions.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using enterprise documents and structured or unstructured data.
Work with vector databases, embeddings, document processing, and semantic search.
Develop backend services and REST APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
Optimize AI applications for accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Implement evaluation, testing, monitoring, and error-handling mechanisms for AI systems.
Collaborate with frontend and backend developers to integrate AI capabilities into business applications.
Follow best practices for data security, privacy, responsible AI, and production deployment.
Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and development practices.

Required Technical Skills

Minimum 3 years of experience in software development, AI engineering, or a related field.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Practical experience with Machine Learning and AI application development.
Hands-on experience with LLMs such as OpenAI models, Gemini, Claude, or open-source alternatives.
Experience with prompt engineering, embeddings, and LLM API integrations.
Knowledge of RAG architectures, vector databases, and semantic search.
